top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at Omloop Het Nieuwsblad Cyclo. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 93 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Omloop Het Nieuwsblad Cyclo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before March.
Omloop Het Nieuwsblad Cyclo's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
At mile 60 of 93, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Omloop Het Nieuwsblad Cyclo. Train it until it feels boring.
At Omloop Het Nieuwsblad Cyclo, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Omloop Het Nieuwsblad Cyclo. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mixed terrain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 93 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Smooth pedaling at 93 miles saves muscle. Bad technique at mile 10 is invisible. At mile 80 it's a cramp.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,996ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Omloop Het Nieuwsblad Cyclo’s 93 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: The technical descents at Omloop Het Nieuwsblad Cyclo demand practice on similar paved roads. Ride mixed terrain at race-day cadence weekly. Practice braking points, corner entry, line choice, and accelerating smoothly out of turns. Confirm tire pressure and equipment before race week.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 93 miles of mixed terrain in Ghent, Belgium.
